note: The §8 experiment from docs/research/IN-THE-WILD-AUDIO.md, run. Primary metric: emitted hz_p05 on speech+hum mixtures. Regression metric: emitted hz_p05 on clean real speech. The notch is applied to the sample array before push() because src/ must not be edited; see the module docstring.

pre_registered_decision_rule.written: before any arm was run; not edited afterwards
pre_registered_decision_rule.clean_med_reference: median emitted hz_p05 over utterances of clean 6 s speech under arm `none`
pre_registered_decision_rule.recovery: R(A) = frac of mixture emitted hz_p05 within 100 cents of CLEAN_MED
pre_registered_decision_rule.clean_shift: SHIFT(A) = median |cents(clean hz_p05 A vs none)|, both clean clips
pre_registered_decision_rule.clean_max_shift: MAXSHIFT(A) = max of the same, both clean clips
pre_registered_decision_rule.delivery: dUTT(A) = utterances with hz_p05 A - none; dVOX = median voiced_ratio diff
pre_registered_decision_rule.coverage: dCELLS(A) = mixture cells emitting >=1 hz_p05, A - none

ship.S2: SHIFT(A) < 10.0 cents on BOTH clean clips
ship.S3: MAXSHIFT(A) < 50.0 cents on BOTH clean clips
ship.S4: dUTT(A) == 0 and |dVOX(A)| < 0.02 on BOTH clean clips

void_if.V2: no-op arm does not reproduce arm `none` bit for bit
void_if.V3: any arm emits zero utterances on clean speech

fixtures.mix: mix(speech, hum, snr_db) -- speech-RMS to hum-RMS
fixtures.gate: one ONNX session, reset per signal; GATE_SPEECH=0.5

methods.filter: RBJ biquads imported from experiments/mic_filter_sim.py; notch Q=10, high-pass Q=0.707 x2 sections

reproduced.note: arm `none`, the unmodified pipeline. These are the numbers from IN-THE-WILD-AUDIO.md §4.3; if they do not reproduce, the harness is not the harness that found the bug.

controls.attenuation_note: measured by pushing a unit sine through the same filter code, not asserted from the design

run_validity.note: VOID means the numbers above exist but must not be used to decide anything. V1 means the harness cannot detect the failure it was built to detect.
